title: Four inks overprinted

techniques.name: Keyline with texture

offset.label: Plate offset
offset.note: How far each riso run sits off true, as a multiple of the page’s own (up to 2 units). 0 prints all four in register.

cover.label: Ink coverage
cover.note: How much of each run’s ink reaches the sheet. Below 1 the inks thin and their overprints lighten.

shiver.label: Edge shiver
shiver.note: How far each riso drum’s edge wanders (the displacement in its coverage filter), as a multiple of the page’s own.

grain.label: Grain
grain.note: The dark grain veil laid over the sheet, as a multiple of the page’s own. 0 leaves the print clean.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-rolls every seeded choice the page makes: the paper, grain, dust and the ink filters’ noise. 0 is the page’s own print.

techniques.implementation: Flat shapes inside a keyline, with a printed texture laid into each shape. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
